'''Mechis II''' was an industrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mechis system/Legends|Mechis system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the world's [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life had adapted to grow inside [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and other machinery.
